# mistershell_syslog_rule (Data Source)

Reads a MisterShell syslog_rule by ID or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_syslog_rule" "example" {
  name = "existing-syslog-rule"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `id` (String) Object ID. Specify either ID or an exact name; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `name` (String) Name.
